official_budget_feasibility.comment: the source's 10s budget buys this many native steps on one worker; MCGS simulations cost several steps each, so the achievable simulation count per decision follows from this number and the graph's branching

_schema_note: RESULTS_SCHEMA places environment_throughput.json under hardware/. This slot previously held a hand-written prose stub written by the finalizer while the ACTUAL measurements sat in benchmarks/ -- a non-schema directory no reader would check. The mandated hardware artifact therefore contained no numbers. Merged: the measurements are authoritative and the operating policy is retained below.

operating_policy.why_one_thread: Without torch.set_num_threads(1) workers contend and the contention is charged against per-decision wall-clock budgets. In c019 that inverted rankings: a harmful search measured 0.605 under load against 0.111 sequentially.
operating_policy.serialization_policy: All latency-bounded MCGS runs execute in ONE serialized queue; nothing runs concurrently with them.
operating_policy.memory_note: Rollout states are released as the rollout advances. Holding them to the end of a decision measured 1.2-1.3 GB per worker and 28.6 GB resident, and 4 games did not finish in 14 minutes; after the fix the same 4 games took 14.7 s.
